sends: Subscribers get a notification about {phase} as soon as it is ready.
waitsForApproval: Notifications about {phase} wait for an administrator to approve them.

reason.noBody: the meeting has no administrative body.
reason.disabled: they are disabled for this body.
reason.unreleased: the meeting is not published. The release creates them, if the meeting is still news then.
reason.not-taking-place: the meeting does not take place on its date (it is postponed or cancelled).
reason.late-agenda: the date of the meeting has passed. The summary is its news.
reason.stale: the meeting is more than 15 days old.
reason.future-summary: the meeting has a future date. Check the date of the meeting.
reason.old-task: the last processing was more than 7 days ago.
reason.noTasks: the agenda and the summary are not processed yet. When they are processed, the subscribers are notified, if the meeting is still news then.

manual: To notify the subscribers anyway, use the Notifications section of the meeting admin page.
